questions.q: After soaking in the potency, medicated globules should be dried:
opts: in the shade, away from sunlight and strong heat
questions.why: Heat and sunlight can damage the medicine, so medicated globules are dried in shade at room temperature.

questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Sepia: bearing down, indifference to loved ones.

questions.q: Pain and tenderness in the right iliac fossa at McBurney's point suggest:
questions.why: Topic 9, Surgery, ENT, Eye and First Aid. One-third of the way from the anterior superior iliac spine to the umbilicus.

questions.q: Delayed, scanty menses, with a mild, weeping disposition, thirstlessness and craving for open air, suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Pulsatilla: changeable, mild, better open air.

questions.q: Rice-water stools with severe dehydration are characteristic of:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. Vibrio cholerae.
